canonical_title: Critical safety item installation, handling, repair, and overhaul

versions.title_at_revision: Critical safety item installation, handling, repair, and overhaul
versions.text:
Standard: The maintenance publications document the CSIs and their CCs which are susceptible to damage from maintenance or handling. The maintenance publications include the statement "CRITICAL SAFETY ITEM” preceding procedural step(s) that could affect a CSI’s CCs IAW MIL-STD-40051, Critical Safety Items paragraph and include instructions to preserve CSIs and their CCs. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examine the complete CSI CCs list with rationale for determination of susceptibility of CCs to damage from maintenance or handling to ensure there is engineering assessment for each determination.
(2) Examine maintenance publications to ensure that CSIs and their CCs susceptible to damage from maintenance or handling are identified and include instructions to preserve CSIs and their CCs.
(3) Examine the artifacts that demonstrate contractor certification or contractor validation to ensure the maintenance publications have undergone a quality check for currency and accuracy IAW TO 00-5-3, Contractor Certification Process and Certification Requirements paragraphs for the Air Force; NAVAIR 00-25-604, Contractor Validation Plan and Validation paragraphs for the Navy; and DA PAM 25-40, Validation paragraphs for the Army. Analysis.
  (1) Conduct Operating and Support Hazard Analysis IAW MIL-STD- 882, Task 206 or a similar hazard analysis of all CSIs and their CCs to determine their susceptibility to damage from maintenance or handling. Demonstration.
    (1) Perform air vehicle maintainability demonstrations to confirm CSI installation, handling, repair and overhaul instructions are complete, accurate, and can be performed as written without introducing AW hazards. Maintenance publications will receive updates to address maintenance issues discovered during maintainability demonstrations. Prior to entering operational test or operations, verify the standard by the following method(s): Demonstration.
    (2) Perform all air vehicle CSI installation, handling, repair, and overhaul procedures on production-configured hardware using government maintenance personnel to ensure maintenance procedures do not damage CSI CC’s.
